newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes lower in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes lower in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.01 lower at 39.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday on a slightly higher buying of the U.S. currency before Friday's weekend closure, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open lower on Saturday, one dealer at Khanani & Kalia International (Pvt) Ltd said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on August 29, stood at 35.6200/35.7981 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 9.80 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
